title: Thoroughly recommend - personal, interesting and fun
text: Great experience. Katherine was full of interesting information, tailored the tour to our needs, answered our questions and was extremely fun and friendly. Enabled us to learn and get real enjoyment from the tour. Value for the price and we would do it again.
author: hannahwU3562FZ

title: Fantastic street art day in Raval
text: I joined my 11-year-old daughter and sister on the street art tour in Raval with Juan and immediately after we did the graffiti workshop at the Three Fireplaces Park. The whole experience was fantastic, thanks to the passion, competence and skill of Juan, who in addition to being an incredible artist, was also an exceptional teacher and a wonderful guide. We sincerely thank him and recommend this activity to anyone going to Barcelona. Surely it was the best moment of our holiday.
author: SajaUto

title: Don't miss this experience!
text: A top experience in a month-long Barcelona stay.  We lucked out and had Olga, co-founder of Street Art Barcelona, as our guide for the Raval tour.  Her knowledge, passion, and stories about the artists and artwork changed the way I saw the city.  I loved sharing what I learned with family, and looking for newly familiar artists and styles as I wandered.  Highly recommend!
author: elizabethsM3798LO

title: Beautiful discovery
text: Meeting place difficult to find but fortunately our guide Anaïs very friendly waited for us and found us. Visit made by a passionate about the history of street art in Barcelona. Very nice meeting we recommend.
